finance-peering-preregistration.implementation-hints: Port PeerLink with injected clock, health probe and caller; a 2xx dict reply records success, a transport failure records failure and raises PEER_UNAVAILABLE with retryable from the new state, other statuses raise ServiceError without touching the state. Port the registry as one JSON file per alias in an explicit directory, read in sorted order. Port TimeConfig.load/save with the source line parser (not java.util.Properties) and int() semantics. Nodes share one in-JVM network of base URLs; a frozen node fails every probe and call. Interbank routes verify with the static settings window and keep no nonces; the mounted gateway keeps its own live window and nonces.
